steps: Node A learns a new membership state.
A exchanges a digest and update with randomly selected B.
B later spreads the newer state to C and other peers.
Repeated rounds probabilistically converge the cluster on version 5.

lesson.scenario: Five membership agents disseminate that node E is unhealthy through randomized peer exchanges.

steps.title: Healthy view
steps.narration: Every live agent records E alive at incarnation 18.
steps.invariant: Incarnation numbers prevent older rumors from replacing newer membership state.

steps.title: Local suspicion
steps.narration: A misses E heartbeats and records a suspicion at incarnation 19.
steps.outcome: Only A knows the new status.
steps.invariant: Gossip begins with local evidence and does not require a central broadcaster.

steps.title: Random fan-out
steps.narration: A randomly selects C and transmits its delta.
steps.outcome: Two agents now carry the rumor.
steps.invariant: A merge keeps the greatest incarnation for each member.

steps.title: Epidemic spread
steps.narration: C tells D while D independently tells B.
steps.outcome: All reachable agents converge after several rounds.
steps.invariant: Convergence is probabilistic; redundant exchanges improve dissemination probability.

steps.title: Stable digest
steps.narration: Agents exchange equal digests and retain the newest rumor.
steps.outcome: No coordinator was needed to spread the failure view.
steps.invariant: A recovered E must refute suspicion with an incarnation greater than 19.
